translations.web: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:
translations.bsb: He makes the grass grow for the livestock and provides crops for man to cultivate, bringing forth food from the earth:
translations.kjv: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
translations.asv: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, And herb for the service of man; That he may bring forth food out of the earth,
